patterns.note: Asymmetrical content blocks within sections, often pairing large, impactful typography on one side with smaller images or abstract graphics on the other.
Highly stylized, pixelated or distressed display fonts are used for major headings, creating a strong visual identity, contrasted with clean, understated sans-serif for body text and labels.
A rich, earthy palette of deep, dark browns and almost-blacks for backgrounds, transitioning to a warm sandy neutral, accented by a subtle gold/cream for key elements and text.
The page features scroll-triggered background color transitions between major sections and elements that fade or slide into view as the user scrolls down.
Full-bleed sections are defined by distinct background colors and often feature large, animated or highly stylized titles that serve as visual anchors.

technique_notes: A full-screen loading animation with a pixelated graphic and text (likely using canvas or GSAP) transitions out to reveal the main page content. Content sections are revealed with a fade-in or subtle slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, orchestrated by a scroll-triggered animation library like GSAP ScrollTrigger. The main page background color smoothly interpolates between distinct hues at different scroll depths, creating a dynamic visual flow.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, highly stylized display headings (~4-5x body) with clean, smaller sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and balanced spacing within content blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive use of pixelated and distressed typography for major headings, combined with a sophisticated dark and earthy color palette and smooth scroll-triggered background transitions, creates a unique blend of modern luxury and digital artistry. The loading screen itself is a memorable brand introduction.
